title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Maha warns against Anbu's second marriage with Vennila. Meanwhile, Kanmani hides her pregnancy, rejects Anbu's advice on health, and is later shocked to see him at the hospital.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman brings Kumaresan and Ganthimathi to Kalamma's house after learning they have been driven out. Despite Kalamma's refusal, he insists they stay.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Divya questions Karna about his attack on Vetri before his court testimony, growing suspicious of him. Shanmugam worries after vacating his tailoring shop and hopes for a new job.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran's family returns happily after the engagement, while he enjoys chatting with Chandayatha. Nadesan helps Sembaruthi at her shop and playfully wishes to marry her.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sathya asks Muthu to train him to drive as Rekha's parents buy him a car. Chandra refuses Sinthamani's jewellery after being humiliated over Rekha and Sathya's grand reception.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Special guest Shruti Haasan lights up the stage, getting emotional over a special clip. Thrilling performances win buzzers, while judge Chithra mesmerises all.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: The finalists reflect on their journey, cherished moments and challenges throughout the season. The countdown to the finale begins, wait and watch to see who emerges as winner!

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Five Make the Cut
description: The Ball Sack Battle sparks fierce competition and emotional moments as Darwin stands out. As the final cards revealed, what would be the final verdict?
